title: 第3章 干了刘艺菲一……
content_zh:
在和陆穿达成口头协定之后，谷川一个人跑到北电乱转，看看能不能招揽到什么人才。

    和陆穿合作的这部电影，谷川是不准备做什么的，主要目的是赚钱。

    但谷川是一个做一步看三步的人。

    他已经在为第二部电影做准备了。

    他进入北电也十分顺利，拿出学生证让门卫看了一眼，就进来了。

    门卫是一年轻小伙，只是颇为遗憾的是，这门卫不姓叶。

    进来的时候倒是顺利，但是进来之后却遇到了一件麻烦事。

    “你站住！！”

    一个鹅蛋脸的女生，突然跑过来拽住谷川的胳膊。

    她微微仰着头，脸上泛着淡淡的红润，染着一层薄怒，似嗔似怪的看着谷川。

    身后还跟着一个女的。

    “同学，你是？”谷川茫然的看着这人。

    “少装蒜！还钱！”

    刘艺菲死死的拽住谷川的袖子，生怕他跑了。

    谷川不解的问道：“同学，你认错人了吧，我没见过你啊，不欠你钱。”

    “就是你，在美国的时候，你骗了几千美元，不要以为你摘了眼镜，我就不认识你了！”刘艺菲恼怒的说道。

    就在年初。

    她在美国遇到了这个男的，当时怎么说的忘了。

    反正就感觉这男人特阳光、特亲善，说的话特好听、特容易让人相信。

    而且他好像什么都懂，什么都能聊两句。

    男人说道格·里曼的《谍影重重》肯定大获成功，他身为南加大导演系的人，可以推荐她到《谍影重重2》演一个配角，只需要6315美元推荐费。

    说实话，钱并不算多，这还是他照顾老乡才给出的低价。

    于是，她稀里糊涂地就被骗了。

    她怀疑谷川能掐会算，怎么知道她就有6315美元的？

    一下子给骗光了！

    “终于让我找到你了！你是怎么混进北电来的？！”

    “哎呀！我想起来了，原来是你！”

    谷川一副恍然大悟的模样。

    “Crystal Liu，对不对。”谷川说道：“我没骗你啊。”

    “那你怎么突然没消息了？”刘艺菲问道。

    “因为我要回国处理事情啊。”谷川笑着说道：“而且《谍影重重2》还没有立项呢，演角色的事情不急，我到时候再联系你。”

    谷川轻轻地扯开刘艺菲的手。

    大庭广众之下的，拉拉扯扯的不好。
content_en:
After reaching a verbal agreement with Lu Chuan, Tanichuan went to Nortel alone to see if he could recruit any talents.

    For this movie with Lu Chuan, Tanichuan is not planning to do anything. The main purpose is to make money.

    But Tanichuan is a person who takes one step and sees three steps.

    He is already preparing for his second film.

    He entered Nortel very smoothly. He took out his student ID card and showed it to the guard before entering.

    The doorman is a young man, but unfortunately, his surname is not Ye.

    It went smoothly when I came in, but I encountered a trouble after I came in.

    "Stop!!"

    A girl with an oval face suddenly ran over and grabbed Tanichuan's arm.

    She raised her head slightly, her face was slightly rosy and dyed with a thin layer of anger, and she looked at Tanichuan with annoyance and strangeness.

    There was a woman following behind.

    "Classmate, who are you?" Tanichuan looked at this person blankly.

    "Stop pretending! Pay back the money!"

    Liu Yifei grabbed Tanichuan's sleeve tightly, fearing that he would run away.

    Tanichuan asked in confusion: "Classmate, have you mistakenly admitted the wrong person? I have never seen you, and I don't owe you money."

    "It's you. When you were in the United States, you defrauded thousands of dollars. Don't think that I won't recognize you if you take off your glasses!" Liu Yifei said angrily.

    Right at the beginning of the year.

    She met this man in the United States and forgot what she said at the time.

    Anyway, I feel that this man is very sunny and friendly, and his words are very nice and easy to believe.

    And he seems to know everything and can talk about anything.

    The man said that Doug Liman's "The Bourne Supremacy" would definitely be a big success. As a director from the University of Southern California, he could recommend her to play a supporting role in "The Bourne Supremacy" for a recommendation fee of only $6,315.

    To be honest, the money is not that much, and this is the low price he gave because he took care of his fellow villagers.

    So, she was deceived in a daze.

    She doubted that Tanichuan could do calculations. How did he know that she had $6,315?

    All of them were deceived at once!

    "Finally I found you! How did you sneak into Nortel?!"

    "Oops! I remembered, it turned out to be you!"

    Tanichuan looked like he suddenly realized something.

    "Crystal Liu, right?" Tanichuan said, "I didn't lie to you."

    "Then why did you suddenly have no news?" Liu Yifei asked.

    "Because I have to go back to China to deal with things." Tanichuan said with a smile: "And the project of "The Bourne Supremacy 2" has not been approved yet. There is no rush to play the role. I will contact you then."

    Tanichuan gently pulled Liu Yifei's hand away.

    It's not good to pull things off in public.
